Title: Pocket Hole Cabinet Screws, 50-Pack
Description:
Stock up on extra pocket hole screws for cabinet installations and filler panel attachment. Ideal for DIY homeowners or pros using pocket joinery, these screws help reinforce strong mechanical connections in plywood cabinetry.

– Designed for cabinets predrilled with pocket screw holes 
– Provides a secure, forgiving hold even under shifting or load 
– Compatible with 5/8" plywood cabinets and filler panels 
– Great for attaching fillers or making on-site adjustments during install 

USE & CARE 
Store in a dry location to prevent rust.

ADDITIONAL INFO 
These screws are ideal if you're assembling cabinets on-site or modifying existing layouts with extra fillers. While our cabinets come predrilled, you may need to drill your own pocket holes depending on your installation configuration. Common in professional-grade cabinetry, pocket screw joinery outperforms lower-end methods like staple-and-glue or plastic corner blocks found in cabinets using 3/8"–1/2" materials.
